newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tietmeyer says sees no change in German rates.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer says sees no change in German rates.

text.p: Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer said on Thursday that he did not expect either an interest rate rise or an interest rate cut in Germany in the foreseeable future.
Asked about the future course of German monetary policy, Tietmeyer said: "I see neither rate rises nor rate cuts in the foreseeable future.
The Bundesbank chief was speaking at a news conference following a regular policy-setting council meeting.
